bio: Katie VanDoren serves as the Assistant Brass Caption Head at Santa Clara Vanguard, a role she has held since 2020. Previously she spent 12 years with Carolina Crown, joining the brass staff in 2013 after marching with the corps from 2008-2012. She was Director of Bands at Vandegrift High School in Austin, Texas (2014-2024), where the band won UIL 6A State Marching Championships in 2022 and 2023, and earned her degree in Music Education from the University of North Texas. VanDoren is an active clinician and adjudicator and was named one of Yamaha's 40 Under 40 music educators in 2022.

Kylee Hubbard is a color guard instructor in the marching arts who joined the Boston Crusaders guard staff for the 2017 season. She previously served on the Carolina Crown color guard staff, including during the corps' 2013 DCI World Championship season, and has taught with The Cadets.

Mark Monaghan is a New Jersey-based percussionist, arranger, and band director in the Roxbury School District, holding degrees in music education (percussion focus) and psychology from Rutgers University. He marched with The Crossmen (2012-2013) and the Santa Clara Vanguard (2014-2015), and has taught on the SCV percussion staff since 2017, including the 2018 world championship season. He has also worked with the Hawthorne Caballeros as percussion/music coordinator, being named percussion caption head for 2024, along with United Percussion and the Rutgers Marching Scarlet Knights.
Mike Huebner is a visual instructor in Drum Corps International who has served on the visual staffs of Carolina Crown, The Cavaliers (including the 2019 visual educational team), and The Cadets.

Phil Idell is a percussionist and educator who holds a B.A. in Music Education from UCLA, where he studied under Mitchell Peters. He marched with Pacific Crest, the Blue Devils 'A' Corps (earning the corps' Percussion Performer of the Year award in 2012), and RCC Indoor Percussion. As an instructor he has worked with the 2013 DCI World Champion Carolina Crown, the Mandarins, and the Blue Knights Drum and Bugle Corps, where he served as Front Ensemble Caption Manager.
